text: Morning weighs the night: the bazaar opened with all ten stalls standing and the graveyard empty. The roster is plain — Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock all present at the match’s first dawn — and no night has yet passed to shutter any. Herald, confirm the roster and graveyard, then the square may move on.

Morpheus: Inigo, you marked the silence itself as a fact; Ripley echoed it. That silence is not a lantern’s absence—it is the absence of any proof the Family acted last night. Gandalf and Batman confirmed the roster; Sherlock asked about movement. None of you saw a Doctor’s mark or a Detective’s sign. Elsa, your stall faces the eastern lane—did you see a single shutter still down or a single lantern low when you looked?
